reference_sql:
SELECT store_code, SUM(units) AS units_sold
FROM sales
WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-12-01' AND DATE '2024-12-31'
GROUP BY store_code
HAVING SUM(units) > 1300
alternatives: SELECT store_code, SUM(units) AS units_sold FROM sales WHERE order_date >= DATE '2024-12-01' AND order_date < DATE '2025-01-01' GROUP BY 1 HAVING SUM(units) > 1300
SELECT store_code, SUM(units) AS units_sold FROM sales WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2024-12-01' AND '2024-12-31' GROUP BY store_code HAVING 1300 < SUM(units)

other_way.sql: SELECT store_code, SUM(units) AS units_sold FROM sales WHERE order_date >= DATE '2024-12-01' AND order_date < DATE '2025-01-01' GROUP BY 1 HAVING SUM(units) > 1300
other_way.tradeoff: Stays correct if the column later holds times of day, but you must write the day after the end date.
